adr_recommendation.text: Keep the command-hook adapter for Codex. Use systemMessage for optional short notices where the surface shows them. Do not use additionalContext or a skill to carry a tester reply that must stay out of model context. Do not port the Claude Code function display hooks to Codex. Treat MCP Apps as an optional desktop display adapter, conditional on the human rendering check. The CLI can use text and warnings; exec needs its external consumer to display results. Keep control-word handling in the Python core. A display is not a trust or relay enforcement boundary.
